title: Conference Speaking And Presentation Skills: Mike Hall Interviews Trisha Gee | GOTO Conference 2015

dimensions.historical_context_at_recording: GOTO Chicago 2015, Jepsen distributed systems testing, microservices vs monoliths debate.
